day1.heading: Sit down
body: You picked this up for a reason. Not the wedding. Not the promotion. A quiet Tuesday.
Here is the line we carry: a real man rejects passivity, accepts responsibility, leads courageously, and expects the greater reward, God's reward.
Sit with it today. Do not wait for a feeling. Read it once out loud.
